metadata.description: The Motir plugin: skills that let a coding agent work a Motir project, the Motir MCP server they reach it through (signed into in the browser), and a runner for the pinned `motir` CLI.

plugins.name: motir
plugins.description: Run the next Motir card end to end, repair a card's red pull requests, log a verified bug, clear the Bugs folder, close a manual card, and be guided through one step by step. Connects the Motir MCP (signed into in the browser) and carries the `motir` CLI runner.
